mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY ( company_code, company_name, business_number, ceo_name, company_type, tel_no, fax_no, email, address, manager_name, manager_tel, status ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{businessNumber}, #{ceoName}, #{companyType}, #{telNo}, #{faxNo}, #{email}, #{address}, #{managerName}, #{managerTel}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT company_id, company_code, company_name, business_number, ceo_name, company_type, tel_no, fax_no, email, address, manager_name, manager_tel, status FROM COMPANY WHERE company_name = #{companyName}
